messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch prioritization for the next 3 sprints. We need to lock down who owns the customer hotpath, what bugs block follow-on milestones, and what can be deferred to enhancements.
liam: +1. We saw a small uptick in 95p latency on the embedding route last night, that's potentially a hotpath item.
alex: CX flagged 3 enterprise customers asking for deterministic caching behavior — they called it a showstopper for their rollout.
sophia: From design: the guided onboarding tweaks are still under review but are lower risk than the caching ask.
sam: Proposal: treat customer-facing regressions that impact SLA as P0. Everything else that reduces quality but not SLA = P1/P2.
maya: Concrete asks: 1) Decide hotpath owner for embeddings + caching. 2) Define "blocker" criteria for feature milestones. 3) Staff rotations for rapid fixes.
liam: I'm happy to be hotpath owner for embeddings this sprint, will coordinate on caching with infra.
alex: +1 for liam. CS will escalate any account-specific reproduction to the #support-signal channel.
sophia: For milestone blocking criteria, suggest: regressions that increase error rate >0.5% or latency 95p > 250ms over baseline = block. Thoughts?
sam: Fine but we should allow a temporary mitigation path (e.g., fallback model variant) instead of full rollback.
maya: Agreed. Add fallback policy as acceptable mitigation.
liam: Quick triage labels I'm going to use in the board: ```triage: p0-blocker, p1-customer-impact, p2-cosmetic, action: rollback, mitigation, schedule```
sophia: Love the labels, helps scoping. Also recommend a short entry criteria for canary of follow-on feature: must pass canary perf < 10% overhead and no P0 regressions for 48h.
maya: Nice. For staffing: liam will be primary, sam secondary on-call for triage, sophia for UX fixes, alex owns customer comms. I'll make a rotation calendar.
alex: We'll prep template messages for affected customers and share with legal where needed.
sam: I'll create a tiny runbook snippet in the ticket: how to flip to fallback variant + smoke commands.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary rollout for v2-guided-onboarding started (build 2026.3.14).
liam: Noted — if we see errors, fallback toggle is ready at /admin/feature-toggle.
maya: Next steps: sam to make runbook + labels (end of day), liam to own hotpath monitoring alerts (tomorrow), alex to notify top 3 customers (EOD). We'll reconvene Thu 10:30 for status. :calendar:
alex: I'll prepare the customer notes and paste them in #customer-comms when ready.
sophia: I'll push a minor UX patch if we see any churn from the canary.
maya: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist for the thread: 
- owners: embeddings = liam, triage = sam, CX comms = alex
- blocker criteria = SLA regressions or >0.5% error or 95p >250ms
- mitigation = fallback variant / region shift / rollback
- rotation: liam primary this week, sam backup
See you Thu.
_meta: generated for dataset: post-launch iteration planning - bugs vs enhancements
